notes: Research hints gathered from public web results. The Research Agent should keep claims conservative and mark uncertain signals as not visibly detected.

c21-revolution-s-a.summary_hint: C21 Revolution S.A. appears as an active inmobiliaria with portal presence, TodoProps contact profile, and Argenprop presence. Public TodoProps result references contact email and a direct contact flow.
c21-revolution-s-a.estimated_activity: Scout estimate: 209 Zonaprop purchase listings. TodoProps profile also showed a smaller direct listing count, so portal counts should be treated as source estimates.
crm_signals: No visible CRM detected from available snippets
pain_points: High listing volume can create a heavy manual qualification load
Portal and contact form inquiries may need faster routing to the right advisor
Franchise-style brand needs consistent response quality across leads
c21-revolution-s-a.outreach_angle: Help the team respond to and qualify portal inquiries faster while keeping a consistent Century 21-style advisory standard.

inmobiliaria-ballarre.summary_hint: Inmobiliaria Ballarre has an official site and long-running local positioning in Miramar, with public contact paths and a portfolio of sale/rental properties. Scout source showed strong portal activity.
inmobiliaria-ballarre.estimated_activity: Scout estimate: 201 Zonaprop listings. Official site highlights selected properties, rentals, sales, appraisals, and seasonal activity.
crm_signals: No visible CRM detected from available snippets
pain_points: Seasonal and rental inquiries can create spikes that are hard to answer quickly
Phone/email/manual website inquiries may be difficult to qualify consistently
Large traditional inventory benefits from automated first response and follow-up
inmobiliaria-ballarre.outreach_angle: Position Optima as a fast-response assistant for seasonal, rental, and sale inquiries without changing their traditional advisory style.

alberti-propiedades.summary_hint: Alberti Propiedades presents as a family real estate firm in Haedo/Moron with more than 15 years in the market, public website/contact form, portal presence, and emphasis on broad property diffusion.
alberti-propiedades.estimated_activity: Scout estimate: 167 Zonaprop listings. Public Zonaprop result for Alberti Propiedades showed 148 listings in another index result.
crm_signals: No visible CRM detected from available snippets
pain_points: Broad portal and website diffusion can fragment inquiries across channels
Contact form leads need fast follow-up and qualification
Personalized family-business service can be protected by automating only the first triage
alberti-propiedades.outreach_angle: Help Alberti respond faster to web and portal inquiries while preserving their personal family-business advisory style.
